documentType.name: supplier agreement
documentType.preamble: This is a commercial agreement between an organisation and a supplier. Key terms may be in schedules or annexes rather than the main body. Where a schedule and the body conflict, prefer the schedule and lower the confidence.

fields.name: supplierName
fields.promptFragment: The legal name of the supplier party, as defined in the parties clause.

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.promptFragment: The commencement or effective date in ISO format. If it is defined as 'the date of the last signature', return null.

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.promptFragment: The end date of the initial term in ISO format. If the term is expressed as a duration, return null rather than calculating it.

fields.name: contractValue
fields.promptFragment: The total contract value including options and extensions, as a number. If the value is a rate rather than a total, return null.

fields.name: autoRenews
fields.promptFragment: True only if the agreement renews automatically unless notice is given.

fields.name: noticePeriodDays
fields.promptFragment: The notice period for termination for convenience, in days. Convert weeks or months only if the document states the equivalent in days; otherwise return null.

fields.name: liabilityCapped
fields.promptFragment: True if the supplier's liability is capped by an amount or a multiple of fees.

fields.name: processesPersonalData
fields.promptFragment: True if the supplier will process personal information on the organisation's behalf, for example a data processing clause or schedule exists.
fields.routingNote: sends the record to privacy review.

fields.name: governingLaw
fields.promptFragment: The jurisdiction named in the governing law clause.
